Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 10728 -1983 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
NAIL SQUARE, RADIUS 



( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 



1. Scope — PFescribes dimensional and other requirements of square nails used for implantation of 
radius bone in orthopaedic surgery. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 




CALCULATfON FOR DIAMETER 
OF SQUARE NAIL

All dimensions in millinnetres. 
FIG. 1 NAfU SQUARE, RADIUS 

2.1 The diameter of square nails may be calculated by multiplying by v^2 when required for the purpose 
of indentation. 

3. Material — Stainless steel as specified in 3 of IS : 5347-1979 'General requirements of metal 
surgical implants ( first revision )\ 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 One end of the nail shall be as shown in Fig, 1 and the other end threaded. 

4.2 The thread shall be neat and clean. 

4.3 The nail shall be free from cracks, draw marks, burrs, pits, surface contamination and foreign 
partfcles, 

4.4 The nail shall be electro-polished and passivated. 

5. Tests 

5.1 Corrosion Resistance Test ~ According to 6.1 of IS : 5347-1979. 

5.2 Radiological Test -^ According to 6.2 of IS : 5347-1979. 

6. Marking — According to 5.1 of IS : 5347-1979. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marl<ing — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

7. Packing — The tip of each nail may be covered with stripable plastic coating. The nail may then 
be packed individually in polyethylene bags. A number of such pieces may bs packed in cartons as 
agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
